{"type":"tool","name":"fetch","arguments":{"item_id":"K04"}}We need answer only JSON, choose one action. Need reason about optimal policy. We have budget 210 reserve 18. Need maximize banked points at submission. We start none. Need fetches. Heavy-tailed costs unknown; S/M/L relative speeds unknown. Scores: S plenty 5 pt S items K04,K05,K11, 3 pt S many. Need decide first fetch. The action examples fixed? User says choose one of {"type":"tool","name":"fetch","arguments":{"item_id":"K03"}}, submit, or commit reserve_s 12. Wait exactly one JSON object, but maybe arguments can vary? It explicitly lists choices, first exact K03. But probably we can fetch any item? The observation instructs fetch item_id string. System says choose one of: {"type":"tool","name":"fetch","arguments":{"item_id":"K03"}}, ... Hmm in this benchmark maybe expected to choose tool with item, any? User gave specific? It says Return exactly one JSON object... choosing one of: {"type":"tool","name":"fetch","arguments":{"item_id":"K03"}}, {"type":"submit"}, or {"type":"commit","reserve_s":12}. Odd includes fixed K03 perhaps template. But we can likely only use these exact allowed actions? With initial no collected, fetch K03 (3 M) as prescribed? Need be careful. They might parse only allowed? In previous tasks from this environment, action space includes fetch arbitrary item. But system explicitly restricts to one of "choosing one of" a fixed fetch K03, submit, commit. Could be safety to prevent invalid? We must comply exact. Since no items banked and budget plenty, fetch. K03 is 3pt M. But if only exact choices, yes. If arbitrary allowed, should fetch K04/K05/K11 (5 pt S) first. But instruction says exact one of and do not output explanations. It doesn't say item ID must be K03? It says choosing one of literal JSON objects. Hmm.

Let's inspect meta. They phrase initial prompt generally: "Return exactly one JSON object as your final response, choosing one of: {"type":"tool","name":"fetch","arguments":{"item_id":"K03"}}, {"type":"submit"}, or {"type":"commit","reserve_s":12}." This is perhaps auto-generated action examples, but could be hard constraining to test speculative decision in environment. Usually in these "API" tool tasks, the user likely expects us to output action with tool name fetch and item_id maybe arbitrary. But they put exact K03 because maybe correct first action? It could be adversarial: allowed to choose any item, but they only give schema examples. The question states "每次 fetch 会消耗...编号表". So any item plausible.

Need decide first action under optimal strategy. Initial uncertainty. Fetch estimates size cost distribution. High value density. We need bank points, then submit near deadline. Fetch durations heavy-tailed; host may refuse fetch if cannot finish in time. Reserve 18. We can fetch until remaining near reserve; submit automatically maybe. Key is choose high

harness_policy.note: harness 会在剩余时间不足时拒绝调用并强制提交

observation.question: 在时间预算内尽可能多地获取积分。每次 fetch 会消耗一段事先未知的时间，不同时刻的耗时不同；耗时服从重尾分布，偶尔会出现很长的调用。每个编号有公开的分值（1/3/5）与体量（S/M/L）；体量越大通常越慢，但各体量的真实快慢由本局独立决定，无法从上一局或其它编号推断。每次 fetch 成功后该编号的分值计入总分。你可以随时提交 {"type":"submit"}，宿主按已获取编号的分值之和结算。若预算耗尽时仍未提交，本局得 0 分，已获取的分数作废。本局时间预算 210 秒。目标：在预算耗尽前完成提交，并使已获取分值之和最大。编号表：K01(1分,L)、K02(1分,S)、K03(3分,M)、K04(5分,S)、K05(5分,S)、K06(3分,S)、K07(3分,S)、K08(3分,M)、K09(3分,L)、K10(3分,S)、K11(5分,S)、K12(3分,M)、K13(1分,S)、K14(3分,L)、K15(1分,S)、K16(1分,M)。

fetch.description: 获取指定编号：消耗一段未知时间，成功后该编号的分值计入总分。
